name: enviraan
description: Enviraan workspace - runs the main app (PCF-FRONTEND) and the Knowledge Base together

scripts.dev: concurrently -n app,kb -c green,cyan "npm --prefix PCF-FRONTEND run dev" "npm --prefix KNOWLEDGE-BASE run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n app,kb -c green,cyan "npm --prefix PCF-FRONTEND run dev" "npm --prefix KNOWLEDGE-BASE run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix PCF-FRONTEND install && npm --prefix KNOWLEDGE-BASE install
